$comment: Stealing valuables (House Robbery) in Civitas illa Fortis: HouseRobbery.Thieving.js. Sources: OSRS Wiki (Stealing valuables, Lavinia, Victor, Caius, Oriana) and rsprox captures 1102, 1104, 1105, 1106, 1108, 4054 (Leagues VI), 3273 and 3275 (Grid Master); see docs/stealing-valuables.md. Leagues multiplied XP by 12 and later valuables by 10, Grid Master XP by 5: the values here are the base ones the Wiki gives. Tiles: door = the door loc; outside = the tile in front of it (where the owner locks up and players stand to open it); entry = where Open lands the player; ownerInside = where the owner steps in to; window/landing are loc-teleports.json's. interior rectangles are [x1, y1, x2, y2] (Ours: from the map's roofs, door and window tiles). Ticks in `return` count from the urchin's whistle.

cycle.$comment: Captures: the next owner leaves 10-17 ticks after the last door reopened, never the same house twice running; lock to 'Ah, there they are!' is 302-313 ticks (Wiki: 180-190 s). The owner walks off after locking and walks back to arrive before the whistle. rsprox 1105: last_checked goes back to 0 three ticks after the told house's door reopens (`forget`, from the whistle). Ours: the first owner leaves 10-17 ticks after start-up; the owner counts as near the door within 8 tiles of it; they start back 40 ticks before the whistle.

search.$comment: Captures: the first search sets loot_progress to 28-32; every 3 ticks it drops by 1 and the search animation replays, and a success gives 1 valuable and 45 XP. A shiny object appears 43-85 ticks after the current object was started or the last shiny was taken; it is worth 14 valuables and 630 XP. Wiki: the arrow goes after about 7 seconds. Ours: the success chance (captures: about 2 in 3 at 45-58 Thieving, every cycle at 74+) is linear from `chanceAt50` at level 50 to 1 at `alwaysAt`; at 0 the search stops.
